content.json:
## O11y Ops findings
Resources at or above a **hot** threshold, from `O11yOpsFindings_CL`. Every Ops run writes one row per hot (resource, metric), so a pair present in the latest run is hot now, and consecutive runs show how long it has been hot. Thresholds come from the config or `o11y-threshold-<metric>-hot` tags. Alerts and Teams cards are routed by `AssignmentGroup`.

parameters.name: OpsCadenceMinutes
parameters.label: Ops run every (min)
parameters.description: Minutes between Ops runs (ops_schedule_cron); used to find the latest run and streaks

parameters.name: Subscription
parameters.label: Subscription
parameters.query:
O11yOpsFindings_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize by Value = SubscriptionId
| order by Value asc

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.label: Resource type
parameters.query:
O11yOpsFindings_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize by Value = ResourceType
| order by Value asc

parameters.name: AssignmentGroup
parameters.label: Assignment group
parameters.query:
O11yOpsFindings_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize by Value = iff(isempty(AssignmentGroup), "(none)", AssignmentGroup)
| order by Value asc

content.query:
let t = O11yOpsFindings_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago({OpsCadenceMinutes} * 1m + 10m)
    | where "*" in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId in ({Subscription})
    | where "*" in ({ResourceType}) or ResourceType in ({ResourceType})
    | where "*" in ({AssignmentGroup}) or iff(isempty(AssignmentGroup), "(none)", AssignmentGroup) in ({AssignmentGroup})
    | summarize Value = dcount(strcat(ResourceId, "|", MetricKey)) by Title = tostring(split(ResourceType, "/")[-1]);
t
| union (t | summarize Value = sum(Value) | extend Title = "all types")
| order by Value desc
content.title: Hot now (resource, metric) pairs

content.query:
let cadence = {OpsCadenceMinutes} * 1m;
let hot = O11yOpsFindings_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where "*" in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId in ({Subscription})
    | where "*" in ({ResourceType}) or ResourceType in ({ResourceType})
    | where "*" in ({AssignmentGroup}) or iff(isempty(AssignmentGroup), "(none)", AssignmentGroup) in ({AssignmentGroup});
let current = hot
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ResourceId, MetricKey
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(cadence + 10m);
let since = hot
    | join kind=inner (current | project ResourceId, MetricKey) on ResourceId, MetricKey
    | summarize by ResourceId, MetricKey, TimeGenerated
    | sort by ResourceId asc, MetricKey asc, TimeGenerated desc
    | extend Key = strcat(ResourceId, "|", MetricKey)
    | extend Break = iff(Key == prev(Key) and prev(TimeGenerated) - TimeGenerated > 1.5 * cadence, 1, 0)
    | extend Streak = row_cumsum(Break, Key != prev(Key))
    | where Streak == 0
    | summarize HotSince = min(TimeGenerated) by ResourceId, MetricKey;
current
| join kind=leftouter since on ResourceId, MetricKey
| project ResourceId, Type = tostring(split(ResourceType, "/")[-1]), Metric = MetricName, ObservedValue = round(ObservedValue, 2), Threshold, Unit,
    ThresholdSource, HotSince, HotFor = now() - HotSince, Owner, AssignmentGroup, CarId
| order by HotFor desc
content.title: Hot now, with how long each pair has been hot (a run where the pair was not hot ends a streak)

content.query:
O11yOpsFindings_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where "*" in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId in ({Subscription})
    | where "*" in ({ResourceType}) or ResourceType in ({ResourceType})
    | where "*" in ({AssignmentGroup}) or iff(isempty(AssignmentGroup), "(none)", AssignmentGroup) in ({AssignmentGroup})
| summarize HotPairs = dcount(strcat(ResourceId, "|", MetricKey))
    by bin(TimeGenerated, {OpsCadenceMinutes} * 1m), Type = tostring(split(ResourceType, "/")[-1])
content.title: Hot pairs per Ops run, by resource type

content.query:
O11yOpsFindings_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where "*" in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId in ({Subscription})
    | where "*" in ({ResourceType}) or ResourceType in ({ResourceType})
    | where "*" in ({AssignmentGroup}) or iff(isempty(AssignmentGroup), "(none)", AssignmentGroup) in ({AssignmentGroup})
| summarize Runs = dcount(RunId), MaxObserved = max(ObservedValue), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    arg_max(TimeGenerated, ResourceType, MetricName, Threshold, Unit, Owner, AssignmentGroup)
    by ResourceId, MetricKey
| extend HoursHot = round(Runs * {OpsCadenceMinutes} / 60.0, 1)
| top 25 by Runs desc
| project ResourceId, Type = tostring(split(ResourceType, "/")[-1]), Metric = MetricName, HoursHot, Runs, MaxObserved = round(MaxObserved, 2),
    Threshold, Unit, LastSeen, Owner, AssignmentGroup
content.title: Top offenders: longest hot in the time range

content.query:
O11yOpsFindings_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where "*" in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId in ({Subscription})
    | where "*" in ({ResourceType}) or ResourceType in ({ResourceType})
    | where "*" in ({AssignmentGroup}) or iff(isempty(AssignmentGroup), "(none)", AssignmentGroup) in ({AssignmentGroup})
| summarize HotPairs = dcount(strcat(ResourceId, "|", MetricKey)), Resources = dcount(ResourceId)
    by Team = iff(isempty(AssignmentGroup), "(none)", AssignmentGroup)
| order by HotPairs desc
content.title: Hot pairs by assignment group

content.query:
O11yOpsFindings_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where "*" in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId in ({Subscription})
    | where "*" in ({ResourceType}) or ResourceType in ({ResourceType})
    | where "*" in ({AssignmentGroup}) or iff(isempty(AssignmentGroup), "(none)", AssignmentGroup) in ({AssignmentGroup})
| where array_length(MissingTags) > 0
| summarize Runs = dcount(RunId), arg_max(TimeGenerated, ResourceType, MissingTags, Owner, AssignmentGroup, CarId) by ResourceId
| project ResourceId, Type = tostring(split(ResourceType, "/")[-1]), MissingTags = strcat_array(MissingTags, ", "), Owner, AssignmentGroup, CarId,
    LastSeen = TimeGenerated, Runs
| order by Runs desc
content.title: Routing gaps: hot resources with missing or unmapped ownership tags (alerts fall to the catch-all route)

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message has "run complete"
| extend j = iff(message startswith "{", parse_json(message), customDimensions)
| where message == "run complete" or tostring(j.msg) == "run complete"
| project timestamp, Mode = tostring(j.mode), RunId = tostring(j.run_id), Inventory = toint(j.inventory_total),
    Evaluated = toint(j.evaluated), Findings = toint(j.findings), RowsWritten = toint(j.rows_written),
    WriteFailures = toint(j.write_failures), TypeFailures = toint(j.type_failures), ChunkFailures = toint(j.chunk_failures)
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Runs (run complete log)

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message has "run complete"
| extend j = iff(message startswith "{", parse_json(message), customDimensions)
| where message == "run complete" or tostring(j.msg) == "run complete"
| summarize Findings = max(toint(j.findings)) by bin(timestamp, 15m), Mode = tostring(j.mode)
content.title: Findings per run

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message has "chunk failed" or message has "type failed" or message has "write failed"
    or message contains "(need: "
| extend j = iff(message startswith "{", parse_json(message), customDimensions)
| extend Msg = iff(message startswith "{", tostring(j.msg), message)
| project timestamp, Msg, Detail = substring(message, 0, 1000)
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Pipeline errors
